name: Honeypot.io
notes: Tech-only marketplace where companies apply to YOU. English-first, DE/AT focus. Strong for Security Engineer + Pentester roles. Berlin / Munich / Hamburg / remote.

name: GermanTechJobs.de
notes: English-language tech jobs in Germany only. Every listing explicitly confirms English-OK. Smaller volume but zero noise.

name: English-Jobs.de
notes: Dedicated to English-speaking jobs in Germany. Wide coverage including security analyst and engineer roles.

name: Berlin Startup Jobs — Security
notes: Berlin tech startups — almost all English-language. Strong for Security Engineer and AppSec entry-level roles.

name: JobsInBerlin.eu
notes: Berlin-focused English jobs. Tech and security strongly represented. Sponsor visa friendly listings flagged.

name: Arbeitnow — Cyber Security
notes: Germany-focused job board with a free API (already wired into the Daily Feed tab). English-language toggle available. Strong for Berlin / Munich.

name: LinkedIn DE — Security Engineer
filter_applied: Security Engineer in Germany, last 7 days
notes: Fresh listings only (7-day window). Use LinkedIn's 'English' filter under 'All filters → Language' to drop German-only postings.

name: LinkedIn DE — Penetration Tester
filter_applied: Penetration Tester in Germany, last 7 days
notes: Pentester / Red Team roles in Germany. Apply LinkedIn language filter for English-only.

name: LinkedIn DE — SOC Analyst
filter_applied: SOC Analyst, entry + associate, Germany, last 7 days
notes: Pre-filtered to entry + associate experience levels (f_E=1,2). L1/L2 SOC roles. Apply English language filter.

name: LinkedIn DE — Red Team
filter_applied: Red Team in Germany, last 7 days
notes: Smaller market — most red team roles in Germany sit in larger consultancies and FS firms. Worth weekly check.

name: LinkedIn DE — Information Security Analyst
filter_applied: Information Security Analyst, entry/associate, Germany, last 7 days
notes: Entry/associate filter applied. Good first-stop search for your target role profile.

name: Indeed DE — Penetration Tester (English)
notes: Adding 'english' to the query filters most German-only listings. Penetration Tester / Red Team roles.

name: Indeed DE — SOC Analyst (English)
notes: SOC L1/L2 entry-level. Add 'visa sponsorship' to the search bar for sponsorship-explicit listings.

name: Indeed DE — Security Engineer (English)
notes: Largest aggregator in Germany. Use Indeed's salary filter (€55k+) to focus on associate-level roles.

name: Stepstone DE — Cybersecurity
notes: One of Germany's largest job boards. Heavily German-language; filter postings carefully or paste into translate.

name: XING DE — Penetration Tester
notes: DACH region's LinkedIn equivalent. Heavily German-language but used by every DE tech recruiter. Worth a profile + monthly check.

name: Glassdoor Germany — Cybersecurity
notes: Cross-reference for company reviews + salary ranges before applying. Useful for vetting smaller German employers.

name: Get-in-IT — Cybersecurity
notes: Targets graduates and early-career IT professionals in Germany. Strong for first-job placements. Mixed German/English.

name: t3n Jobs — Security
notes: German digital industry magazine's job board. Modern startups + scale-ups, often English-friendly.

name: Heise Jobs
notes: Major German tech publisher. Job board heavily used by traditional German IT employers. German-language but high quality.

name: JobMESH
notes: Tech-focused aggregator. Mix of remote and on-site DE roles.

name: Welcome to the Jungle — Germany
notes: Modern, company-profile-rich. English-first interface. Strong on culture and product info per employer.

name: Wellfound — Germany Security
notes: Formerly AngelList. Startup-heavy, equity-first comp. Some sponsor visas. English-language by default.

name: Make-it-in-Germany (official)
filter_applied: Official jobs portal for skilled migrants
notes: Official German government portal for non-EU skilled migrants. Pre-screened for visa-sponsorship potential. English interface.

name: BSI Careers (Federal Office for IT Security)
notes: German federal cyber agency. Public-sector security roles. Lengthy process. Some English-friendly intern + dual-language posts.

name: Bundesagentur für Arbeit — IT Security
notes: Official federal labour agency database. Authoritative for visa-relevant roles. German-language interface.

name: Hays Germany — Cybersecurity
notes: Global recruiter, large Germany office. Strong contract + perm pipeline for security roles.

name: Michael Page DE — Cybersecurity
notes: Professional staffing firm. Mid-senior security roles in Frankfurt, Munich, Berlin. Sponsor-aware recruiters.

name: Robert Half DE — Cybersecurity
notes: Global staffing firm with strong DACH presence. Good for SOC and Security Analyst roles.
